title: ynh baseline --format json
description: Output of `ynh baseline <harness> --format json`. Reports what a harness's ratchet currently forgives. The baseline stores twelve-character fingerprints rather than findings, so without --explain this describes the shape of the debt; with --explain the sensors are run and the fingerprints resolved into the lines they forgive.

unrecorded.description: Sensors forgiving nothing. A sensor absent from the baseline was passing when it was taken — different from one recording zero.

forgiven.description: Total distinct findings forgiven across all sensors.

recorded_at.description: When this sensor's debt was accepted.

total.description: Raw count a count-ratchet sensor is measured against.

truncated.description: Too many findings to store fingerprints, so only the count is ratcheted.

findings.description: The lines the recorded fingerprints forgive. Present only under --explain. A finding that no longer appears is omitted: it has been fixed and the baseline can be narrowed.
